name: telegram-archive-manager
description: Unofficial Telegram Archive Manager — archive and browse the Telegram channels/groups your account can access.

scripts.build:packages: npm run db:generate && tsc -b packages/shared packages/crypto packages/database packages/storage packages/telegram
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @tam/api -w @tam/worker -w @tam/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && npm run test:integration --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && tsc -b apps/api apps/worker && concurrently -k -n tsc,api,worker,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput apps/api apps/worker" "npm run dev:run -w @tam/api" "npm run dev:run -w @tam/worker" "npm run start -w @tam/web"
